0.1.0.title: First release
0.1.0.summary: Keystone reads your track library, shows key, tempo and energy on a Camelot wheel, and writes what it finds back to your files.
highlights: Camelot wheel: pick a key and the library narrows to it and everything that mixes with it.
Key, tempo and energy on every row, with cue markers you can drag on the waveform.
Where the key is genuinely ambiguous, Keystone shows both instead of guessing a letter.
Write key, energy and tempo into your tags, or into the filename, with a preview and an undo.
Send cue points to rekordbox and Traktor. Your collection is backed up before anything is written.
Collections, ratings and search over your whole library.
Everything runs on your machine. No account, no uploads.
